charts.title: Quarterly revenue review
charts.description: Revenue in millions of US dollars for each region and quarter.
charts.summary: Compare regions across quarters in one view.

charts.title: Web engagement analysis
charts.description: How many web sessions fall at each combination of session length and pages viewed.
charts.summary: See how session length and pages viewed are distributed together.

charts.title: Customer segmentation
charts.description: One sphere per customer, placed by recency, order frequency and average order value, sized by estimated lifetime value and colored by segment.
charts.summary: Spot clusters by recency, purchase frequency, and spend.

charts.title: Product portfolio profitability
charts.description: One tile per product line, with area for its share of revenue, height for its operating margin and color for its segment.
charts.summary: Revenue share and operating margin for each product line.

charts.title: Wind and airflow modeling
charts.description: One arrow per measurement point showing wind direction, with length and brightness for speed in meters per second.
charts.dataset: Vector field for Wind and airflow modeling.csv
charts.summary: See direction and speed across a block of airspace.

charts.title: Team collaboration mapping
charts.description: One sphere per person, colored by team and sized by how many ties they have, with a beam for each working tie.
charts.dataset: 3D network graph for Team collaboration mapping.csv
charts.summary: Find hubs and bridges between departments.
